description: B30 (switch-in handlers sort by action Speed, which Trick Room reverses). Setup turn 1: Excadrill sets Trick Room. Setup turn 2: the double KO of ko-replace. The replacements Abomasnow (Snow Warning, raw Speed below Pelipper's) and Pelipper (Drizzle, raw 85) come in under Trick Room: `updateSpeed()` gives `10000 - speed`, so the slower Abomasnow's handler runs first and rain remains (raw Speed order would leave snow).
